04Good to know

Questions, answered.

What is Milo’s Cafe known for?

Our focaccia sandwiches, voted best sandwiches in the Triangle, along with thoughtfully crafted Lavazza coffee and food made from scratch.

Where is Milo’s Cafe?

Milo’s Cafe is at 10119 Chapel Hill Rd, Morrisville, NC 27560.

What does Milo’s Cafe serve?

Lavazza espresso and coffee drinks, matcha, specialty lattes and teas, plus focaccia sandwiches, salads, toast and bowls, and sweet or savory crepes, all made from scratch.

Can I order online for pickup or delivery?

Yes. Order through our online ordering page for pickup, curbside or delivery, or come in and dine with us.

Is there outdoor seating?

Yes. We have indoor seating and a patio with bistro chairs and shaded tables.

What time does Milo’s Cafe close?

We’re listed as closing at 4 PM. Hours can vary, so call (919) 443-8000 to confirm today’s hours.

Do you have vegetarian options?

Yes, including avocado toast, goat cheese toast, veggie focaccia and several crepes. Please ask us about ingredients and allergens.
